scope: Four ordinary dry families: walking/eating20-update held-transform transitions, including interruption, save reconstruction and final interpolation interval.

rules: StartBlend captures held current transform including active blend
BlendTransform keeps incoming image/frame and blends transforms/alpha; source skew outside180degree window is ignored
Update decrements blend counters even at zero animation rate

implementation.oldPose: Saved source clip/phase and prior held blend; discarded when transition finishes
implementation.sourceCounter: 20 then decremented to19 on first update; freezes stop clip clocks but do not stop blend counter; game pause stops both
implementation.parts: Original ActorRig sprites retained; shared per-family track lookups and per-rig scratch poses reused

remaining: Full original pixel parity: imported pose metadata precision and layer visibility variants not exhaustively proven
Walk2/random spawn and source-faithful headless phases remain incomplete
Other zombie families, accessory removal and water-state blends not ported here
Highly adversarial rapid repeated interruptions retain chained held-pose descriptors until transition completes; full engine stores per-track numeric transforms
Total process CPU/RAM, physical iPhone Safari loading and heat not measured
